item: PF11 built: LESSONS.md is consulted by grep through a generated index, with a size ratchet
summary: Rule (1) no longer asks every session to read the 1.08 MB LESSONS.md in full. python scripts/lessons.py finds the entries that bear on the work at hand (search, --index, --show); the index is generated and never committed. A zero-slack line ratchet on LESSONS.md (twin of CLAUDE.md's) stops it growing unseen. CLAUDE.md alone stays mandatory in full.
